items.stem: Complete the statement: An accrued expense is …
options: an expense of a future period
an expense incurred in the period but not yet paid
items.answer: an expense incurred in the period but not yet paid
items.markingKey: an expense incurred in the period but not yet paid. Accruals concept [1]

items.stem: Explain why an accrued expense is added to the amount paid when calculating the income statement charge.
items.answer: The expense has been incurred in the year even though it is unpaid; the accruals concept requires all expenses incurred in the period to be matched against its revenue.
items.markingKey: Incurred in period [1]; accruals/matching concept [1] [2]

items.stem: Explain the effect on profit and on the statement of financial position of failing to record a prepaid expense.
items.answer: Expenses are overstated, so profit is understated; current assets are understated by the amount of the prepayment.
items.markingKey: Profit understated [1]; current assets understated [1] [2]

items.stem: Baobab Furnishings paid $26,410 for rent during the year ended 31 December. $1,400 had been paid in advance at 1 January. Calculate the amount for rent to be charged in the income statement for the year.

items.stem: Explain the difference between accrued income and income received in advance.
items.answer: Accrued income is earned in the period but not yet received (a current asset); income received in advance is received but relates to a later period (a current liability).
items.markingKey: Accrued – earned not received, asset [1]; in advance – received not earned, liability [1] [2]

items.stem: Explain why income received in advance is treated as a liability.
items.answer: The business still owes the goods or service to the payer; until it is earned it is an obligation, and it will become income in the next period.
items.markingKey: Obligation to provide service [1]; becomes income later [1] [2]

items.answer: The adjustments were reversed: income owed at the year end is added and income received in advance at the year end is deducted. Correct income figure: $14,340.

items.stem: Isla calculated a draft profit of $56,230 for Volcano Spices for the year ended 31 December. It was then found that: (i) wages owing of $860 had not been recorded (ii) commission of $2,320 received for next year had been included in income. A trainee accountant calculated the corrected profit as $59,410. State the mistake made and give the correct profit.
items.answer: Each adjustment was applied in the wrong direction: unrecorded expenses and income received in advance reduce profit; prepaid expenses and accrued income increase it. Correct profit: $53,050.
